contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 1 TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($393.90) on the p2 Summary Page, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 393.90 and its printed 'Total Contributions Received' 393.90
contributions.detail: Schedule A (PDF p3) carries TWO entries on lines 1 and 2 of a 17-line grid: 200.00 + 193.90 = 393.90 exactly = the schedule's printed subtotal = its printed total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell. THE IN-KIND CONVENTION IS MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND: line 1 is marked '(in-Kind)' by the filer beside the amount and it is INSIDE the printed 393.90 — cash-only would leave 193.90, which the document never states. The balance ladder closes: line 3 beginning 18,378.67 + line 4 393.90 = line 5 18,772.57; minus line 6 12,935.93 = line 7 5,836.64. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 56,295.79, a genuine cycle cumulative on this 30-days-after-Primary report, and is never summed as an increment. The unused remainder of the grid is crossed out with several large looping strokes — the §E3 CONTRAST CASE: a stroke across the LEFTOVER grid, which voids no row, consumes no line and shifts no index (crop-proved: the entry on band 1 is intact and band 3 is empty).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($12,935.93) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 12,935.93 and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' 12,935.93
expenditures.detail: Schedule B (PDF p4) carries FIFTEEN entries filling lines 1-15 of its 17-line grid: 6128.79 + 1.10 + 750.00 + 18.85 + 159.80 + 2.99 + 29.00 + 326.05 + 3000.00 + 750.00 + 150.00 + 325.75 + 941.60 + 349.00 + 3.00 = 12,935.93 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Column A, and the same figure is repeated on the cover at line 6. No in-kind item is marked on this side, so both conventions coincide. Column B YTD prints 50,459.15 and is not summed. A single long wavy stroke runs across the two unused lines below the last entry — again a leftover-grid stroke, not a voided row (the one-past-the-end control rendered an empty amount cell).

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-PLUS-in-kind on the contributions side; not applicable on the expenditures side. Tested on BOTH sides of THIS filing (§G1): Schedule A closes only WITH the 200.00 the filer marked '(in-Kind)' (cash-only leaves 193.90 against a printed 393.90), while Schedule B marks nothing in-kind and closes at 12,935.93 either way. Note the in-kind gift is NOT mirrored as an offsetting expenditure here — unlike McCabe 2018 in this same chunk, whose three in-kind items appear on both sides.
itemized.escalation_note: One escalation, on the p4 line-9 payee cell, whose dense cursive was cropped at 1400 dpi: it reads 'Syzygy Solutions' with '(campaign phone calls)' bracketed after it, though the letterforms would also support a literal 'Sygzgs' and that doubt is recorded on the row rather than resolved. No AMOUNT was in doubt: both schedules close to the cent on their own printed subtotals and totals AND on the cover's Column A cells, and the cover's balance ladder closes as well, so every figure is corroborated three ways inside the document. The remaining crops recorded in the frames are geometry proofs.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Chad Grunander' (handwritten), party 'Republican', residence Provo; Office Seeking written 'Utah County Attorney', which agrees with index.csv's channel label 'County Attorney'. index.csv names no candidate; the page face supplies it. Report type '30 Days after the Primary Election (if eliminated at the Primary)' — consistent with the index period label 'Out at Primary'; amendment answered 'No'; signed and dated 7/25/2018, with the same date in the Date of Report box on all three inner sheets. The clerk's 'For Office Use Only' box is EMPTY — no received stamp of any kind. FORM STOCK: the cover is the county-only title 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' with the Code 2-5 & 17-16-6.5 citation (its side rail reads 'County & Local School Candidates'), and all three inner sheets are strap-lined '2018 County & Local School Candidates' — GENUINELY 2018-DATED stock, the same third 2018 wording as the Phelps filing in this chunk. Schedule B's payee column is headed 'Provider/Vendor'; neither schedule has a Purpose column. DOCUMENT SHAPE: 4 pages = cover / SUMMARY PAGE / Schedule A / Schedule B, and here the summary IS at p2 — but it was located by its printed heading, and note the filer felt the need to hand-write '(Summary page)' beside the foliation box. FOLIATION: each of the three inner sheets is numbered 'Page 1 of 1' independently — an ELEVENTH practice for the running tally, and one that says nothing about the document as a whole. ROW-INDEX TRAPS SCREENED: on both schedules the first written entry is band 1 (crop-proved), there is no banner and no continuation line, and the §B5 one-past control rendered an empty amount cell on each. ⚠ BOTH SCHEDULES CARRY LARGE PEN STROKES ACROSS THEIR UNUSED GRID — several big loops on Schedule A and one long wave on Schedule B — and both are §E3 LEFTOVER-GRID strokes, not voided rows: they cross empty lines only, void nothing, and shift no index, which the control crops confirm. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: columns assigned by CONTENT against the printed headings. Two departures are recorded on their rows and neither makes a column unassignable — one expenditure cell names no payee at all (only what the payment was for, with 'Online' in the address column), and the filer's amount-cell annotations ('(in-Kind)', '($200 less PayPal fee)') sit OUTSIDE the printed amount column to its right. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted and prints full mailing lines for both donors and every vendor; the two contribution rows were reduced to city/state at READ TIME, expenditure rows carry no address field in this record, and no street line was written into any field or note.
